newsitem.title: USA: Philadelphia Liberty Medal goes to CNN.
newsitem.headline: Philadelphia Liberty Medal goes to CNN.

text.p: Cable News Network's international news division has won the 1997 Philadelphia Liberty Medal, the selection committee said.

Ted Turner will accept the award and the accompanying $100,000 prize in a ceremony on July 4, the committee announced on Tuesday. Previous awards have recognized King Hussein of Jordan, retired Supreme Court Justice Thurgood Marshall and South Africans Nelson Mandela and F.W. de Klerk.
Turner founded CNN before selling it to Time Warner. Martin Meyerson, chairman of the selection committee, said the cable network exercised a growing influence on world leaders and citizens alike.
